title: In 1963, a Volcano Built a Brand New Island From the Sea Floor

scenes.text: In 1963, a volcano built a brand new island out of the sea.
It began one hundred and thirty meters underwater, off Iceland.
Black smoke broke the surface, and within days the island was five hundred meters long.
It kept erupting for three and a half years, until June of 1967.
By then it stood one hundred and seventy-four meters tall.
An island that didn't exist before 1963. Watch it rise again.

description:
In 1963, a volcano built a brand new island out of the sea off Iceland.
It began erupting 130 meters underwater and kept going for 3.5 years, building the island of Surtsey.
What would you name a brand new island?
first_comment: Bonus: Surtsey is now about half its original size, because waves keep wearing it away. Would you want to be the first person to step on a brand new island?
